planets.name: TOI-1221 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1221 with a 91.7-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-1221 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1221. Its orbit and size follow Mann et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
